description: For every equality-axiom model \(N\), actual scoped formula \(A\), free assignment \(v\) and slot assignment \(w\), \(Q_N\models A[q\circ v,q\circ w]\) if and only if \(N\models A^E[v,w]\), including quantified formulas.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.quotient_truth.{u, v, w, z} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type w}
  {N : Type z} [(Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.Extended L).Structure N]
  (h : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.Axioms L N) {n : ℕ} (A : L.BoundedFormula α n) (v : α → N)
  (w : Fin n → N) :
  A.Realize (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.projection h ∘ v)
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.projection h ∘ w) ↔
    (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.translate A).Realize v w
